author: BasedJames88
quote:
Your days are numbered rockstar. Biggest bait and switch in entertainment history.

You were sold a deep, immersive world with everything previous GTA games were and more - Instead, You got soyboy-beta-cuck-errand boy boyfriend simulator.
It's so blatant that this game was written by blue haired women (Who think they understand men) for women. 

The story does pickup a lot towards the end of chapter one. But boy does chapter one drag on and on. 

It's also very clear that they put the fiveM team to work too - And the fiveM team should be proud of their contribution to the series. Because overall, If you look at the game as a simulated / RP experience, It is a 9.5/10 game. Only reason for the 0.5 deduction here is the bugs related to interacting with things.
